$comment: 语法大厅 G22（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：谁是主奏、谁是伴奏、谁是装饰——主干（主谓宾）是主奏，状语是伴奏，定语是装饰音。与 G21（五种编制）配套：G21 认句型，本课练拆句。呼应 G10 形副分工。全部内容原创。
title: 句子成分识别
metaphor: 谁是主奏、谁是伴奏、谁是装饰
ketNote: KET 不直接考术语，但 Part 3/4 的长句全靠「找主干」读懂；写作的破句（有装饰没主奏）也从这里治。

sections.essence: 先找主奏（主谓宾），再认伴奏（状语）和装饰（定语）——长句只是穿了戏服的短句。
sections.why: 很多孩子一见长句就懵：The tall boy in a blue coat plays the drum very well in the morning.——十四个词！可这句的骨架只有四个词：boy plays the drum。其余全是穿在骨架上的戏服：tall 和 in a blue coat 是打扮 boy 的「装饰」，very well 和 in the morning 是衬托动作的「伴奏」。读不懂长句，几乎都是把装饰错当了主奏。中文同样有定语状语，但有一个关键差别：中文的定语全站在名词前面（「穿蓝外套的男孩」），英语的定语只要一长就跑到名词后面去（the boy in a blue coat）——这件「后置戏服」是中国孩子读长句的头号陷阱。学会三步剥洋葱——圈动词、往前找谁、往后找什么——再长的句子也会当场现出短句原形。
sections.metaphorStory: 小凡第一次听乐队合奏，愁眉苦脸：「这么多声部，到底谁是主角？」老团长笑了：「有个笨办法，百试百灵——抽掉试试。」他先把主奏小提琴按停——曲子当场塌了，散成一堆声音。「听见没？抽掉就塌的，是主奏。句子里就是主语、谓语、宾语：The boy plays the drum，抽掉哪个都不成句。」他又把打拍子的低音提琴按停——曲子瘦了一圈，但还认得出来。「抽掉只是变瘦的，是伴奏。句子里是状语：very well、in the morning、at the park——说时间地点方式，去掉句子照样站着。」最后他抹掉几个装饰音——旋律素了些，骨架纹丝不动。「这是装饰。句子里是定语：tall、in a blue coat，都是给名词穿的戏服。」小凡恍然大悟，回去把长句一件一件脱戏服，最后每句都只剩四五个词的短句。老团长说：「记住，写句子先保主奏——一句话全是戏服没有主奏，那不是句子，是一堆衣服。」

cards.rule: 主奏三件：主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
cards.detail: 谁（主语）、做（谓语）、什么（宾语）——抽掉任何一件，句子塌台。这是句子的骨架。

cards.rule: 装饰 = 定语：给名词穿的戏服
cards.detail: 修饰名词。短戏服（单个形容词）站名词前；长戏服（介词短语等）跑到名词后——这是中文没有的规矩。
cards.example: a tall boy / the boy in a blue coat / something to drink

cards.rule: 伴奏 = 状语：衬托动作
cards.detail: 说时间、地点、方式、频率，修饰动词或整句。位置灵活，句首句尾都行——但绝不插进动词和宾语中间。
cards.example: yesterday / in the park / carefully / always

cards.detail: 抽掉就塌 → 主奏（主干）；抽掉变瘦 → 伴奏（状语）；抽掉变素 → 装饰（定语）。
cards.example: (tall) boy plays (the) drum (very well) → boy plays drum 不能再抽

cards.detail: ① 圈出谓语动词；② 往前找「谁」；③ 往后找「什么」——剩下的全是戏服，先放一边。
cards.example: My cousin from Shanghai bought a scarf for Grandma. → cousin bought a scarf

cards.rule: 戏服分岗位：形容词管名词，副词管动词
cards.detail: 装饰名词用形容词（careful），伴奏动词用副词（carefully）——岗位别站错（G10 的老朋友）。

basic.cn: 小猫喝牛奶。（主奏：cat drinks milk；little 是装饰）

basic.en: My best friend plays chess well.
basic.cn: 我最好的朋友棋下得好。（well 是伴奏）
我们昨天参观了博物馆。（yesterday 抽掉，句子还站着）

basic.en: The girl with long hair sings.
basic.cn: 长头发的女孩在唱歌。（with long hair 是后置戏服）

basic.en: Birds fly high in the sky.
basic.cn: 鸟儿在天上飞得高。（high、in the sky 都是伴奏）

mid.en: The boy in the blue coat plays the drum very well.
mid.cn: 穿蓝外套的男孩鼓打得很好。（骨架：boy plays the drum）

mid.en: My uncle from Hangzhou brought us a box of tea.
mid.cn: 杭州来的叔叔给我们带了一盒茶。（from Hangzhou 修饰 uncle）

mid.en: She always does her homework carefully after dinner.
mid.cn: 她总是晚饭后认真写作业。（always/carefully/after dinner 全是伴奏）

mid.en: The songs on this list are my favourites.
mid.cn: 这张单子上的歌都是我的心头好。（on this list 是 songs 的后置戏服）

mid.en: Everyone in our class likes the new music teacher.
mid.cn: 我们班每个人都喜欢新来的音乐老师。（in our class 修饰 everyone）

trap.en: The boy near the window is my deskmate.
trap.cn: 窗边那个男孩是我同桌。
trap.note: near the window 是戏服不是伴奏——它贴着 boy，说的是「哪个男孩」。

trap.en: I like this song very much.
trap.note: very much 是伴奏，只能站句尾——绝不插进 like 和 song 中间。

trap.en: He always gets up at six.
trap.note: 频率伴奏 always 的专座在实义动词前——不在句尾。

trap.en: There is something interesting in today's newspaper.
trap.cn: 今天报纸上有点有意思的东西。
trap.note: something 的戏服永远穿在身后——something interesting，不是 interesting something。

trap.en: The man with a ladder cleaned the windows quickly.
trap.cn: 带梯子的那个人很快擦完了窗户。
trap.note: with a ladder 贴着 man（哪个人）；quickly 贴着 cleaned（怎么擦）——一件戏服一个伴奏。
good 在这里不是装饰是「镜中样子」（表语）——镜子句是 G21 的老朋友。

redBlack.bad: The boy in the blue coat with a big drum on his back.（整句想说他很酷）
redBlack.good: The boy in the blue coat carries a big drum on his back.
redBlack.why: 从头到尾全是戏服，没有谓语——一堆衣服不是句子，听的人等不到「他怎么了」。

redBlack.bad: In the park yesterday morning with my friends.（想说昨天去公园玩了）
redBlack.good: I played in the park with my friends yesterday morning.
redBlack.why: 只有伴奏没有主奏——谁？做了什么？主干缺席，意思传不出去。

redBlack.bad: I like very much this song.
redBlack.good: I like this song very much.
redBlack.why: 伴奏不能插进动词和宾语中间——动宾是连体的，very much 去句尾。
同一条规矩——先说完 reads the letter，伴奏再进来。

redBlack.bad: He drives very careful in the rain.
redBlack.good: He drives very carefully in the rain.
redBlack.why: 伴奏动词要用副词 carefully——careful 是名词的戏服。

redBlack.bad: She is a very carefully girl.
redBlack.good: She is a very careful girl.
redBlack.why: 给名词穿戏服用形容词 careful——岗位反着站也不行。

redBlack.bad: The in the blue coat boy is my brother.
redBlack.good: The boy in the blue coat is my brother.
redBlack.why: 长戏服必须穿在名词后面——introduce 到前面就穿反了。

redBlack.bad: I want interesting something to read.
redBlack.good: I want something interesting to read.
redBlack.why: something/anything 的戏服永远穿在身后。

redBlack.bad: He gets up always at six.
redBlack.good: He always gets up at six.
redBlack.why: 频率伴奏 always/usually/often 的专座在实义动词前面。
「唱得美」是给动词伴奏——beautifully；beautiful 只能装饰名词。

redBlack.bad: Yesterday we cleaned the room. / We cleaned the room yesterday. 哪个对？
redBlack.why: 伴奏位置灵活，句首句尾都合法——只是别插进动宾中间。

redBlack.bad: We sang songs in the hall last night. 顺序必须先地点后时间吗？
redBlack.good: 先地点后时间更顺口；倒过来意思也不挡。
redBlack.why: 两个伴奏连用的习惯顺序是地点在前——不是硬规则，KET 不设坑。

contrast.cn: 穿蓝外套的男孩（戏服全在名词前）
contrast.en: the boy in a blue coat（长戏服跑到名词后）
contrast.diff: 中文定语一律前置；英语「短前长后」——介词短语戏服一定后置，这是读长句的头号陷阱。

contrast.cn: 我非常喜欢这首歌。（「非常」贴着动词）
contrast.en: I like this song very much.（very much 排在句尾）
contrast.diff: 中文状语站动词前；英语动宾连体不可拆，伴奏只能绕到句尾。

contrast.en: 英语没有「的」——靠位置认戏服。
contrast.diff: 中文有标记词；英语全凭位置：贴名词的是装饰，贴动词的是伴奏。

contrast.cn: 他总是六点起床。（「总是」位置随意些）
contrast.en: He always gets up at six.（always 有专座）
contrast.diff: 英语频率词的专座在实义动词前、be 动词后——记座位号。
英语长句是「骨架+戏服」结构——先圈动词找主奏，戏服放一边，读得又快又准。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 圈动词，前找谁，后找什么；抽掉塌的是主奏，抽掉瘦的是伴奏，抽掉素的是装饰。
steps: 圈出谓语动词——整句的心脏。
往前找「谁」（主语），往后找「什么」（宾语）——主奏三件到齐。
剩下的词挨个「抽掉试试」：句子塌了？它是主干，放回去。
抽掉只是变瘦（时间/地点/方式/频率）→ 伴奏；贴着名词说「哪个、什么样」→ 装饰。
写句自查：主奏三件齐不齐？伴奏有没有插进动宾中间？戏服的长短前后穿对没有？

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『抽词游戏』。你说一句英语长句，比如 The tall boy in a blue coat plays the drum very well。现在我当剪刀，一次剪掉一个词或一小段，你告诉我：曲子塌了，还是只是瘦了？剪掉 plays——塌了吧？那它是主奏，赶紧放回去。剪掉 very well——还站着？那它是伴奏。剪掉 tall——句子只是素了点？那是装饰。最后咱们把所有能剪的都剪光，看看这句的骨架到底剩几个词。」玩熟了反过来：你给她三个词的骨架（boy plays drum），让她一件件往上穿戏服、配伴奏，看能穿多长——穿得越长还不塌，功力越深。
questions: 一句话的「主奏三件」是哪三件？抽掉会怎样？
The girl with long hair sings well. 里，with long hair 贴着谁？well 贴着谁？
「非常喜欢」为什么不能说 like very much this song？very much 该站哪里？

sections.echo: 「主语」「宾语」这两个名字本身就藏着两种文明的比喻。英语的 subject 来自拉丁语 subiectum——「被扔在底下的东西」，句子的地基；object 来自 obiectum——「被扔到对面的东西」，动作投过去砸中的目标。罗马语法家满脑子都是「扔」。而中文叫「主语」「宾语」——主人和宾客：主人坐堂上发话，宾客在对面受着。一个文明用投掷打比方，一个文明用待客打比方，说的却是同一件事：句子里有个发起者，有个承受者。你今天学的「主奏与伴奏」，不过是第三种比喻——比喻会换，句子的骨架不会变。

memoryCard.alt: G22 记忆卡：主奏=主谓宾抽掉就塌；装饰=定语（短前长后，something 后置）；伴奏=状语（位置灵活但不拆动宾，always 专座在实义动词前）；剥洋葱三步：圈动词、前找谁、后找什么；警示 like very much this song、sings beautiful。

questions.q: 句子的「主奏三件」是？
questions.explain: 谁+做+什么——抽掉就塌的三件。

questions.q: 抽掉后句子只是「变瘦」的成分是？
questions.explain: 时间地点方式抽掉，句子还站着。

questions.q: 给名词「穿戏服」的成分叫？
questions.explain: tall、in a blue coat——都是名词的戏服。

questions.q: The small dog barked. 里的 small 是？
questions.explain: small 贴着 dog——抽掉句子只是素了。

questions.q: We sang loudly. 里的 loudly 是？
questions.explain: loudly 说「怎么唱」——贴着动词的伴奏。

questions.q: The boy in a red hat waved. 里 in a red hat 贴着谁？
questions.explain: 介词短语紧跟名词时是它的后置戏服。

questions.q: 英语的「长戏服」（介词短语定语）穿在名词的？
questions.explain: 短前长后——the boy in a blue coat。

questions.q: 读长句的第一步是？
questions.explain: 剥洋葱三步的第一步——找到心脏。

questions.q: Mum cooked noodles last night. 的骨架是？
questions.explain: last night 是伴奏——抽掉不塌。

questions.q: 「非常喜欢」的 very much 站在哪里？
questions.explain: 动宾连体——I like it very much。

questions.q: always/usually 这类频率伴奏的专座在？
questions.explain: He always gets up at six。

questions.q: something 的戏服穿在？
questions.explain: something/anything 的戏服永远后置。

questions.q: 装饰名词用什么词？伴奏动词用什么词？
questions.explain: careful driver / drives carefully——岗位分明。

questions.q: 一句话只有戏服没有谓语，它是？
questions.explain: 没有主奏的一堆衣服——先补谓语。

questions.q: The girl reads books in the library. 里 in the library 是？
questions.explain: 它说动作发生的地点——伴奏。

questions.q: 「抽掉试试」时句子塌了，说明抽掉的是？
questions.explain: 抽掉就塌＝主奏——放回去。

questions.q: The boy ___ is my cousin.（穿黑T恤的）
questions.explain: 长戏服后置——boy in the black T-shirt。

questions.q: She speaks English ___.（说得很流利）
questions.explain: 伴奏动词用副词——fluently。

questions.q: He is a ___ worker.（细心的）
questions.explain: 装饰名词用形容词——careful worker。

questions.q: I ___ drink milk before bed.（总是）
questions.explain: 频率伴奏站实义动词前——always drink。

questions.q: There is ___ in the box.（一些好玩的东西）
questions.explain: something 的戏服后置——something fun。

questions.q: We enjoyed the picnic ___.（非常）
options: very much 放 enjoyed 后宾语前
questions.explain: enjoyed the picnic very much——伴奏去句尾。

questions.q: The house ___ has a red roof.（河边的）
questions.explain: house by the river——长戏服后置。

questions.q: The choir sang ___ at the festival.（动听地）
questions.explain: 伴奏用副词 sweetly。

questions.q: My grandpa walks ___ every morning.（慢慢地）
questions.explain: walks slowly——副词伴奏。

questions.q: The students ___ hand in homework on time.（通常）
questions.explain: usually 站实义动词前。

questions.q: I need ___ for the trip.（一个更大的包）
questions.explain: 单个形容词戏服前置——a bigger bag。

questions.q: The lady ___ is our neighbour.（带两只小狗的）
questions.explain: lady with two puppies——长戏服后置。

questions.q: He answered the question ___.（礼貌地）
questions.explain: answered...politely——副词伴奏在句尾。

questions.q: ___ we water the sunflowers.（每天早上——放句首）
questions.explain: 时间伴奏可站句首——Every morning, ...

questions.q: Is there ___ in the fridge?（什么好吃的）
questions.explain: anything 的戏服也后置——anything nice。

questions.q: The music ___ made everyone stand up.（来自舞台的）
questions.explain: music from the stage——长戏服后置。

questions.q: 哪句的动宾没被拆开？
options: She likes this story very much.
She likes very much this story.
She very much likes only story.
questions.explain: likes this story 连体——very much 句尾。

questions.q: 哪句的戏服穿对了位置？
options: The man at the door is a postman.
The at the door man is a postman.
At the door the man is postman a.
questions.explain: 长戏服后置——man at the door。

questions.q: 哪句的岗位没站错？
options: The tortoise walks slow and slow.
questions.explain: walks slowly——副词伴奏动词。

questions.q: 哪句的岗位对了？（他是个安静的孩子）
questions.explain: quiet 形容词装饰 boy——quietly 是副词，别混岗。

questions.q: 哪句的频率词坐在专座上？
options: Often Lily visits always her grandparents.
questions.explain: often 站实义动词前。

questions.q: 哪句的 something 穿对了戏服？
options: I heard something strange last night.
I heard strange something last night.
I heard something strangely last night.（想说奇怪的东西）
questions.explain: something strange——戏服后置且用形容词。

questions.q: 哪句是完整的句子（有主奏）？
options: The girl in the front row asked a question.
The girl in the front row with a red pen.
In the front row with a red pen.
questions.explain: 只有第一句有谓语 asked——另两句全是戏服。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我妹妹跳舞跳得很好）
options: My little sister dances very well.
My little sister dances very good.
My little sister very well dances.
questions.explain: well 是副词伴奏，站句尾。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他认真地读完了那封信）
questions.explain: 动宾连体 read the letter，carefully 收尾。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（山顶上的风很大）
options: The wind on the mountain top is strong.
The on the mountain top wind is strong.
The wind is on the mountain top strong.
questions.explain: wind on the mountain top——戏服贴着名词后置。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我从不迟到）
options: I am never late for school.
I never am late for school.
Never I am for school late.
questions.explain: 频率词在 be 动词后——am never late。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（戴眼镜的老师教我们数学）
options: The teacher with glasses teaches us maths.
The with glasses teacher teaches us maths.
The teacher teaches with glasses us maths.
questions.explain: with glasses 贴 teacher 后置；别插进动宾。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这只鹦鹉说话说得清楚）
questions.explain: 伴奏动词用副词 clearly。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（昨晚的雨下得很大——用伴奏收尾）
options: It heavily rained last the night.
questions.explain: heavily 副词伴奏；last night 时间伴奏押后。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（她想要一杯热的东西）
options: She wants something hot to drink.
She wants hot something to drink.
She wants something hotly to drink.
questions.explain: something hot——后置 + 形容词。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（教室后面的钟停了）
options: The clock at the back of the classroom stopped.
The at the back of the classroom clock stopped.
The clock stopped at the back of the classroom.（想说「后面的钟」）
questions.explain: at the back... 是 clock 的戏服，要贴着它——挪到句尾就成了「停在教室后面」。

stages.name: 用一用 · 剥洋葱读长句

questions.q: The old man with a wooden stick feeds the pigeons in the square every morning. 骨架是？
options: man with a stick every morning
questions.explain: 圈动词 feeds，前找 man，后找 pigeons——其余全是戏服和伴奏。

questions.q: My cousin from Chengdu sent me a panda toy last week. 骨架是？
questions.explain: 三重奏骨架：cousin sent me a toy。

questions.q: The girl in the yellow dress near the piano is my sister. 里，near the piano 贴着谁？
questions.explain: 两件戏服都穿在 girl 身上——黄裙子的、钢琴旁边的那个女孩。

questions.q: The students in Class Three practise the new song in the hall after lunch. 哪些是伴奏？
options: in the hall 和 after lunch
in Class Three 和 the new song
questions.explain: in Class Three 贴 students 是戏服；in the hall、after lunch 说地点时间——伴奏。

questions.q: 抽掉哪部分后这句就塌了？——The bird on the wire sings sweetly at dawn.
questions.explain: 谓语是心脏——抽掉 sings 只剩一堆词。

questions.q: 给骨架穿衣服：boy reads books → 加「图书馆里」「每天」：
options: The boy reads books in the library every day.
The boy in the library every day reads books.
The boy reads in the library books every day.
questions.explain: 动宾连体 reads books，伴奏排后面。

questions.q: 给骨架加戏服：the dog barked → 加「隔壁的」（next door）：
options: The dog barked the next door.
Next door the dog barked.（想说隔壁的狗）
questions.explain: 长戏服后置——the dog next door。

questions.q: 哪句的「谁在弹」最清楚？——想说：穿校服的女孩在弹琴。
options: The girl in school uniform is playing the piano.
The girl is playing the piano in school uniform.
In school uniform is playing the girl the piano.
questions.explain: 戏服贴紧 girl；挪远了会像「穿着校服弹琴」的伴奏。

questions.q: The boys ___ the kite ___.（高兴地放风筝——填对岗位）
questions.explain: flew the kite happily——副词伴奏收尾。

questions.q: 找出破句（没有主奏）：
options: The tall trees along the quiet road behind our school.
Tall trees line the quiet road.
The road behind our school is quiet.
questions.explain: 第一句从头到尾没有谓语——一堆戏服。

questions.q: The singer ___ practises ___ in the small room ___.（每天/认真地/楼上的——排对三件）
options: upstairs 修饰 room：The singer practises carefully in the small room upstairs every day.
every day 插在 practises 和 carefully 中间
carefully 放句首其余不动也最自然
questions.explain: 戏服 upstairs 贴 room；两个伴奏 carefully、every day 依次排后。

questions.q: Everyone in the hall clapped loudly when the show ended. 主句骨架是？
questions.explain: clapped 独奏；in the hall 戏服；when... 是挂上来的时间小句。

questions.q: 哪句最可能引起误会？——想说：用望远镜的男孩看见了一只鸟。
options: The boy with the telescope saw a bird.（清楚）
The boy saw a bird with the telescope.（戏服离家出走）
questions.explain: with the telescope 贴 boy 才是「拿望远镜的男孩」；挪到句尾就可能变成「用望远镜看见」——戏服离主人越近越清楚。

questions.q: 把三个成分排成最自然的一句：主干 we watched the stars ＋ on the roof ＋ last Saturday night
options: We watched the stars on the roof last Saturday night.
We watched on the roof the stars last Saturday night.
We last Saturday night watched the stars on the roof.
questions.explain: 动宾连体；伴奏先地点后时间。

questions.q: The little cat under the piano is listening quietly. 各就各位判断哪项全对？
options: under the piano＝cat 的戏服；quietly＝伴奏
questions.explain: under the piano 说「哪只猫」；quietly 说「怎么听」。

questions.q: 大考：找骨架——My best friend from the music club lent me his favourite CD after class yesterday.
options: friend from the music club yesterday
questions.explain: 三重奏骨架 friend lent me CD；from the music club 是戏服，after class、yesterday 是伴奏——剥完洋葱只剩五个词。

detective.sentence: I like very much the songs of this band.
detective.fixed: I like the songs of this band very much.
detective.clue: 动宾是连体的——very much 这段伴奏只能排到句尾。

detective.sentence: The in the red scarf girl is our monitor.
detective.fixed: The girl in the red scarf is our monitor.
detective.clue: 长戏服要穿在名词后面——girl in the red scarf。

detective.sentence: My brother plays the drum very good.
detective.fixed: My brother plays the drum very well.
detective.clue: 给动词伴奏要用副词 well——good 是名词的戏服。

detective.sentence: She gets always up at half past six.
detective.fixed: She always gets up at half past six.
detective.clue: 频率伴奏 always 的专座在实义动词前面。

detective.sentence: We saw interesting something at the science fair.
detective.fixed: We saw something interesting at the science fair.
detective.clue: something 的戏服永远穿在身后。

detective.sentence: The tall boy in the blue coat with a drum on his back.（想介绍他会打鼓）
detective.fixed: The tall boy in the blue coat carries a drum on his back.
detective.clue: 整句全是戏服没有谓语——先给句子装上心脏。

detective.sentence: He answered polite the teacher's question.
detective.fixed: He answered the teacher's question politely.
detective.clue: 两处病：伴奏要用副词 politely，而且不能插进动宾中间。
